ei.title: 아프리카에 대한 서구의 깊은 개입 필요성
ei.subject: ReadingPower유형편완성

fullPassage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa ①<u>should go</u> far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and ②<u>require</u> sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ③<u>ranks</u> high in this category. The majority of Africans today ④<u>make</u> their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② require → requires: 주어 'Western involvement'가 단수이므로 3인칭 단수형 requires가 와야 함. 복수형 require는 비문.
det.analysis:
✅ ① should go: 조동사 + 동사원형 — 원문 일치
❌ ② require → requires (주어 Western involvement 단수. 3인칭 단수 현재형 requires)
✅ ③ ranks: 단수 주어 The matter에 3인칭 단수 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ make: 복수 주어 Africans에 동사원형 make — 원문 일치
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치. 단수 주어(involvement) + 단수 동사(requires).

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. African farmers ③<u>earns</u> very low per-hour wages, and they are ④<u>able</u> to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ earns → earn: 주어 'African farmers'(복수)에 3인칭 단수형 earns는 불가. 복수 동사 earn이 맞음.
det.analysis:
✅ ① ranks: 단수 주어(The matter)에 단수 동사 — 원문 일치
✅ ② commercial: 형용사(farmers 수식) — 원문 일치
❌ ③ earns → earn (주어 African farmers 복수. 복수 동사 필요)
✅ ④ able: 형용사(be able to) — 원문 일치
det.tip: 복수 주어 → 복수 동사. earns(단수)는 비문.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make ④<u>their</u> living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they ③<u>cannot compete</u> with farmers ①<u>who receives</u> state subsidies ②<u>to plant</u>, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① who receives → who receive: 선행사 farmers(복수)를 받으므로 관계대명사절의 동사도 복수 receive가 맞음. receives는 비문.
det.analysis:
❌ ① who receives → who receive (선행사 farmers 복수. 관계절 동사 복수)
✅ ② to plant: to부정사 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ cannot compete: 조동사 + 동사원형 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ their: 소유격 — 원문 일치
det.tip: 관계대명사절 동사는 선행사 수에 일치. farmers(복수) → receive.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The matter of agricultural subsidies ranks high in this category. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious obstacle to fair competition. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries ①<u>to gradually stop</u> these subsidies — if they really ②<u>believing</u> ③<u>their own</u> words about free trade — and ④<u>to give</u> African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② believing → believe: 'if they really ____ their own words' — 조건절의 본동사 자리. 현재분사 believing은 본동사 불가.
det.analysis:
✅ ① to gradually stop: split infinitive 허용 — 원문 일치
❌ ② believing → believe (if절의 본동사 자리. 분사는 단독 본동사 불가)
✅ ③ their own: 소유격 + 강조 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ to give: to부정사 — 원문 일치
det.tip: if + 주어 + 본동사. 분사(-ing)는 단독 본동사 불가.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires ①<u>sacrifices</u> from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. The majority of Africans today make their living as commercial farmers, and for them, subsidies in rich countries are a serious ④<u>support</u> to fair competition. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ support(지원)는 원문 obstacle(장애물)의 반의어. 부유국의 보조금이 공정 경쟁의 '장애물'이라는 본문 논지에 반대되는 단어.
det.analysis:
✅ ① sacrifices: 희생 (모든 부유국의 희생 요구) — 원문 일치
✅ ② stop: 중단하다 (보조금 중단 요구) — 원문 일치
✅ ③ compete: 경쟁하다 — 원문 일치
❌ ④ support → obstacle (부유국 보조금은 공정 경쟁의 '장애물'. support는 정반대)
det.tip: a serious obstacle to fair competition — 공정 경쟁의 장애물. support는 반의어.

questions.passage: Western involvement in Africa should go far beyond the purchase of oil and minerals, and requires sacrifices from all wealthy countries, Western and non-Western. But they ③<u>cannot</u> compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to ④<u>suddenly</u> stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about ①<u>free trade</u> — and to give African farmers their chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ suddenly(갑자기)는 원문 gradually(점진적으로)의 반의어. 보조금을 '점진적으로' 중단한다는 본문 흐름에 반대되는 단어.
det.analysis:
✅ ① very low: 매우 낮은 (낮은 임금/가격) — 원문 일치
✅ ② cannot: 조동사 부정 (경쟁할 수 없음) — 원문 일치
❌ ③ suddenly → gradually (점진적 중단. suddenly는 반대)
✅ ④ free trade: 자유 무역 — 원문 일치
det.tip: to gradually stop these subsidies — 점진적으로 중단. suddenly(갑자기)는 반의어.

✅ ① S2 일치: 농업 보조금 문제가 중요 순위
✅ ② S4 일치: 차, 면화, 카카오, 바나나 저가 판매

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ cannot to → cannot: 조동사 can/cannot 뒤에는 동사원형이 직접 와야 함. to는 추가될 수 없음.
det.analysis:
✅ ① involvement: 명사 주어 — 원문 일치
✅ ② as: '~로서'(자격) 전치사 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ able: be able to 구조 — 원문 일치
❌ ④ cannot to → cannot (조동사 뒤 동사원형만 가능. to 삽입 불가)
det.tip: as + 명사 = ~로서(자격/직업). like + 명사 = ~처럼(비교).

African farmers earn very low per-hour wages, and they are able to market their tea, cotton, cacao, and bananas at very low prices. But they cannot compete with farmers who receive state subsidies to plant, harvest, export, and market their produce. It is up to the rich countries to gradually stop these subsidies — if they really believe their own words about free trade — and to give African farmers their chance.
